as_told.title: Asberg's 1996 UFO sighting after waking unusually early

plain: Dennis Asberg, a Swedish treasure hunter, says that one early summer morning in 1996, after waking unusually early for no reason he can explain, he saw a round craft over a military site outside Stockholm. He says that seen from one angle it looked like a hot dog, and he mentions UFO Sweden, a Swedish group that collects sighting reports. He tells it on Jesse Michels's podcast as his own unexplained encounter near a military base.
